title: One-Click Performance Analysis Inside Business Central
summary: An extension adds AI-powered performance analysis directly into Business Central's Performance Profiler, detecting anti-patterns and explaining results without switching tools. It helps developers understand slow transactions quickly by identifying root causes like N+1 queries, unfiltered record operations, and event subscriber hotspots.
key_points: One-click analysis button on the Performance Profiler page runs pattern detection and AI-powered explanation of performance bottlenecks
Detects anti-patterns including N+1 queries, unfiltered FindSet, method dominance, deep call stacks, and event subscriber hotspots
Optional source code upload enables syntactic analysis to prove nesting and catch performance issues not yet visible in profiles
Available as BC extension for quick profile-only analysis or web app for full analysis with source correlation
